what: The perf-flagged LOOSE_CASE quotes stock 1.99 us as "device kernel duration" but golden device_kernel_ns comes from the realtime profiler (eval/profiling.py), which reads ~350 ns higher than Tracy DEVICE KERNEL DURATION on the same call (P: 1.98-2.04 us vs 1.64 us). Whether the op beats stock depends on which metric is meant, and nothing says which.
suggest: Name the metric behind every stock/roofline figure in LOOSE_CASES extras, and state in perf_rules.txt which metric gates perf refinements (golden realtime vs Tracy kernel duration).
